claims.quote: We investigated the safety and efficacy of arimoclomol, which amplifies the heat shock response to target NPC protein misfolding and improve lysosomal function, in patients with NPC.
Arimoclomol provided a significant and clinically meaningful treatment effect in NPC and was well tolerated.
